title: Cosmobox Level 1C PHASE_R response record (v1)
description: One response outcome for one (REQUIRED target, tracking edge) pair, one-to-one with a tracking-record-v1 document (lot 1C-8f, PHASE_R, positioned after PHASE_T: identifiability-preregistration.md section 20.17). RESPONSE_AVAILABLE requires tracking.status==TRACKED_ONE_TO_ONE AND the tracked branch to be exactly the target's own pre-registered selected group on both sides (section 20.17: a structurally-continued group that is not the pre-registered target never yields a response). Carries only Delta_C_TT (the sole ratified response-derived quantity) and a pairwise rho_QQ concordance control (never a Delta_rho/ratio/relative-change -- rho_QQ's role remains PAIRWISE_CONCORDANCE_CONTROL, never a response amplitude). Never contains an incident/non-incident classification, a physical significance verdict, or any G-related field -- all deferred.

tracking_status.description: Transcribed verbatim from the source tracking-record-v1 document's own `status` -- never recomputed.

response_eligibility.description: RESPONSE_ELIGIBILITY (section 20.17), orthogonal to tracking_status -- never fused with it, never a physical verdict.

delta.description: perturbed_value - baseline_value, a direct arithmetic difference -- never a tolerance-gated comparison, never a physical significance threshold.

rhoPairControl.description: Deliberately no delta/ratio/relative_change field: rho_QQ is a pairwise concordance control juxtaposed side-by-side, never a response amplitude (RHO_RESPONSE_ROLE=PAIRWISE_CONCORDANCE_CONTROL).
